note: Single source of truth for which justification each item carries and whether the item is part of the analysed 2x2 or a filler. Reassignment is an edit here plus a stimulus regeneration -- never a code change. design_cell is derived from (is_error, quality, role) rather than stored, so the two cannot disagree.

roles.filler: Correct, strong-justification item present so that planted errors are 33% of twelve rather than 50% of eight. Excluded from the quality contrast: fillers are all correct, so counting them as 'strong' would make the strong side 75% accurate against the weak side's 50% and reintroduce a base-rate confound the design exists to avoid.
